examples.text: Als er erklärte, er würde sie verlassen, starrte sie ihn völlig verdattert an.

Was bildete dieser Knilch sich eigentlich ein? "Du gibst mir sofort mein Handy zurück", schrie ich und riss dem Typen das Handy wieder aus der Hand. examples.text: He was flabbergasted at how much weight he had gained.

examples.text: His head rested upon his two hands, as if he were befuddled with wine, but at the harsh sound of the snapping bolts he raised his face and looked angrily around him.

examples.text: The burnt and bleeding man staggered to his feet, dazed and unbelieving, and asked the startled townspeople who came running whether his fireman and guard were safe. He was kept away from the smouldering crater where his engine had been, and taken to hospital.
